executionContract.requirementGoal: Deliver the requirement described by the delivered docs: `Design/docs/current/recipe-coldstart-production-quality-original-plan-2026-07-15.md`, `Design/docs/current/recipe-coldstart-production-quality-requirement-design-2026-07-15.md`
approvedPlan: Confirm the selected Dashboard project is the BiliDili Ghost identity with project id 02a25032 before observing the run.
Capture a pre-trigger baseline: no active jobs, selected project identity, Recipe/candidate/publication counts and relevant file/log timestamps.
Wait for the user to trigger exactly one Dashboard cleanup-rebuild action; Test must not click, submit, restart, or create the job.
Track the resulting job id and timeline through Dashboard/API/job store/logs and record the first divergence or terminal outcome.
Map the observed Dashboard action to the real source entrypoint, controller/job orchestration, AlembicCore/AlembicAgent/Alembic composition, persistence, publication, and UI readback paths.
If the run reaches completion, inspect generated Recipe quality and exact public readback; if it fails, stop at the first product failure while preserving diagnostic evidence.
Report this as a diagnostic observation only; it cannot replace or pass the separately defined four-scenario formal production matrix.

boundaryGate.question: Does one real, user-triggered BiliDili Dashboard cleanup-rebuild cold-start traverse the intended production code chain and produce internally consistent, durable, publicly readable Recipe results without lifecycle, lineage, semantic-review, or connectivity defects?
boundaryGate.objectBoundary: The currently selected BiliDili Ghost project (project id 02a25032), one user-triggered Dashboard cleanup-rebuild cold-start job, and the exact runtime/code chain that produces, persists, publishes, and reads back its Recipe results. Observation only; no product mutation except the user's single UI action.
controllerSelfChecks: Alembic daemon is ready at http://127.0.0.1:61879 and the BiliDili project resolves to Ghost project id 02a25032.
Current Alembic job listing shows no new or active BiliDili job before dispatch; latest visible job is historical.
Accepted runtime artifact manifest/load receipt and environment binding revalidation receipt exist at state revision 316.
A Recipe-only backup exists, but it is not a whole-root snapshot and does not authorize destructive reset/restore operations.
The user explicitly authorized real BiliDili cold-start monitoring in this conversation on 2026-07-30.
realScenarioConditions: Alembic daemon remains the existing local service at http://127.0.0.1:61879.
Dashboard remains on the existing BiliDili selection and the identity is confirmed as Ghost project id 02a25032.
The user, not Test or controller automation, performs exactly one cleanup-rebuild trigger after the observer is ready.
Production provider/config and accepted prebuilt runtime artifacts remain unchanged during observation.
Test reuses the current environment and stops at the first product failure or after collecting terminal-success evidence.
successMeans: Exactly one user-triggered Dashboard cleanup-rebuild creates an attributable BiliDili job using project id 02a25032 and the expected data root.
Dashboard, API, job store, logs, bootstrap session, files, publication lineage, and public readback agree on the lifecycle and terminal result.
The observed source call chain reaches the accepted production Core/Agent/Alembic composition, durable semantic review, persistence/publication, and public consumption paths.
A completed run produces non-empty, source-grounded Recipes whose identities, evidence, semantic review, publication state, and visible readback can be correlated.
The result envelope provides sufficient raw evidence for independent controller diagnosis and does not overclaim the formal four-scenario matrix.
failureMeans: The Dashboard action does not create exactly one attributable BiliDili job or creates a job against the wrong project/data root.
Dashboard, API, job store, bootstrap session, logs, files, publication, or readback disagree on lifecycle state or terminal outcome.
The job stalls, fails, silently falls back, reports success with missing/invalid Recipe output, or leaves partial/corrupt state.
The implemented code path bypasses the accepted production artifacts, semantic evidence authority, durable review, persistence, publication, or exact public readback chain.
Required diagnostic evidence cannot be captured without mutation beyond the user-triggered action.
cannotConclude: This observation cannot establish that the full TEST_MR_ALEMBIC_PRISTINE, TEST_MR_ALEMBIC_REBUILD, TEST_SP_BILIDILI_PRISTINE, and TEST_SP_BILIDILI_REBUILD matrix passed.
A terminal Dashboard label alone does not prove the underlying job, persistence, publication, semantic review, and public readback chain succeeded.
Historical jobs, pre-existing Recipes, or the Recipe-only backup cannot be counted as output of this observed run.
The observer may not conclude source fixes are correct without controller review of raw evidence and matching code/test validation.
stopConditions: Stop immediately if the selected project identity or data root is not BiliDili project id 02a25032.
Stop if a BiliDili job is already active before the user trigger, or if more than one new job appears and attribution is ambiguous.
Stop at the first product failure after preserving the corresponding job/log/state/file evidence; do not restart or repair.
Stop if any required evidence would require source/data/config/runtime mutation by Test.
Stop after terminal success evidence is captured; do not run a second cleanup-rebuild under this card.

evidenceRequired: Pre-trigger baseline with timestamp, selected project identity, active-job count, relevant counts, and runtime/log/file locations.
Observed user-trigger event time and resulting job id, kind, source, request, and project/data root identity.
Timestamped job-state timeline and corresponding Dashboard/API/job-store/log evidence through terminal state or first product failure.
Actual code call-chain references connecting the Dashboard action to orchestration, Core/Agent/composition, persistence/publication, and UI readback.
For success: generated Recipe identities/counts/content-quality sample, durable semantic review evidence, publication lineage, and public readback correlation.
For failure: first failing boundary, exact error/log excerpt location, partial state/data effects, retry/fallback behavior, and rollback/recovery risk.
Explicit separation between verified facts, inferred causes, unresolved questions, and conclusions that remain forbidden.
allowedOperations: Read current BiliDili Ghost identity, Alembic status, Dashboard/API job state, daemon logs, generated artifacts, Recipe outputs, and relevant source code.
Observe and timestamp exactly one user-triggered Dashboard cleanup-rebuild job from pre-trigger baseline through terminal state or first product failure.
Use read-only Alembic and host diagnostics to correlate Dashboard state, job-store state, runtime files, logs, and source call chain.
Return a TargetResultEnvelope with raw evidence refs, observed inputs/outputs/state transitions, code-path findings, defects, risks, and conclusions.
forbiddenOperations: Do not click or submit the Dashboard cleanup-rebuild or any other job-start control.
Do not invoke Alembic bootstrap/rescan/job creation, restart, cancellation, reset, repair, restore, installation, build, or patch operations.
Do not modify BiliDili source, Alembic product source, configuration, database, data root, Recipes, candidates, logs, or runtime artifacts.
Do not create a replacement environment, whole-root snapshot, or destructive reset/restore workflow under this diagnostic card.
Do not dispatch implementation fixes or treat this observation as formal Test-matrix acceptance.
